description: Hold a single Dagster step open until a condition becomes true -- Airflow's sensor-mode operators (PythonSensor, BashSensor, FileSensor, TimeSensor, TimeDeltaSensor).

outputs.description: Materializes once the condition is met (or on_timeout='skip' after a timeout).

condition.description: 'callable': callable_path() returns truthy. 'shell_exit_zero': command exits 0. 'file_exists': a path matching file_pattern exists. 'time_of_day': now (in timezone) has passed time_of_day. 'delay': delay_seconds have passed since the run's reference time.
condition.label: Condition

callable_path.label: Callable Path
callable_path.description: condition='callable' only (required then): 'module.path:function_name', called with no arguments each poll, returning truthy/falsy.

command.label: Command
command.description: condition='shell_exit_zero' only (required then): shell command run via bash -c each poll.

retry_exit_code.label: Retry Exit Code
retry_exit_code.description: condition='shell_exit_zero' only: this exit code means 'not ready yet, keep polling' (Airflow BashSensor's retry_exit_code). Any OTHER non-zero exit code fails immediately instead of polling further. Unset: any non-zero exit code fails immediately.

file_pattern.label: File Pattern
file_pattern.description: condition='file_exists' only (required then): a glob pattern (e.g. '/data/inbox/*.csv') checked each poll.

time_of_day.label: Time Of Day
time_of_day.description: condition='time_of_day' only (required then): 'HH:MM' (24h) in `timezone`. Met once today's wall-clock time has passed it.

delay_seconds.label: Delay Seconds
delay_seconds.description: condition='delay' only (required then): seconds after the run's reference time that must have passed.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Give up after this many seconds total.

on_timeout.label: On Timeout
on_timeout.description: 'fail' (default): raise and fail the run. 'skip': materialize successfully with metadata timed_out=true (Dagster has no native per-asset 'skipped' status; same convention as shell_command_asset's skip_on_exit_code).

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds
